name: Thailand

fees.name: Tourist Visa (embassy/consulate-issued, single entry, incl. e-Visa applications submitted via thaievisa.go.th)
fees.notes: Government fee schedule from Bangkok Immigration Division 1 lists Tourist Visa issuance at 1,000 THB per entry. This is the domestic issuing/changing-type-of-visa fee; consular tourist visa fees charged abroad may differ by embassy/consulate and were not separately confirmed on an official page during this check.

fees.name: Thailand e-Visa (Ministry of Foreign Affairs online application, thaievisa.go.th)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities requiring a visa, varies by visa category (tourist, transit, non-immigrant, etc.)
fees.notes: The official MFA e-Visa portal (thaievisa.go.th) requires selecting nationality and visa category before a fee is shown; no fixed published fee table found on the public pages during this check. Third-party sources cite figures around USD 40-99 depending on nationality/processing speed, but these are NOT official and were not used. Treat the underlying visa-category fee (e.g. Tourist Visa 1,000 THB per the Immigration Bureau fee schedule) as the closest official reference.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival
fees.validity: 15 days, single entry, cannot be extended
fees.applies: nationals of ~19-31 eligible countries not on the visa-exemption list (varies by current government notification)
fees.notes: 2,000 THB, payable in cash (THB only) at the immigration counter on arrival; non-refundable even if refused. Fee has been periodically waived for specific periods/nationalities by Thai government notification - travellers should check current waiver status before travel.

fees.name: eTA / electronic travel authorisation
fees.notes: Thailand does not operate a separate eTA scheme distinct from its e-Visa system as of this check. Visa-exempt travellers instead complete the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online, which carries no fee.

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa (Business/B category), single entry
fees.applies: eligible nationalities requiring a visa for business purposes
fees.notes: Multiple entry: 5,000 THB per year (or 5,000 THB per 3 years for APEC-member nationals).

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: 90 days from issue date, max 30 days per stay
fees.applies: transit passengers requiring a visa staying >12 hours

reciprocity_variations.note: Royal Thai Embassy New Delhi consular fee schedule effective 27 April 2026: Tourist Visa single entry INR 3,000, multiple entry INR 13,500 - separate from the VFS logistics/service charge. Indian ordinary-passport holders also benefit from a visa-exemption arrangement for short tourist stays under current Thai notifications, so this fee applies only where a visa is actually required.

vfs.note: VFS Global is the official visa outsourcing partner for the Royal Thai Embassy in India. Service/logistics fee varies by centre: approx. INR 250 at Mumbai/Pune/Goa/Ahmedabad centres, INR 500 at Chennai/Cochin/Bengaluru/Hyderabad centres, charged in addition to the government visa fee (e.g. INR 2,500 for single-entry tourist visa). Fee levels are third-party-reported based on a VFS notice; confirm current amount on the VFS India-Thailand portal before relying on it.

free_visa_notes: Thailand is visa-free/visa-exempt on arrival for many nationalities (durations vary, commonly 30-60 days) under bilateral agreements; visa-exempt travellers must instead complete the free online Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) before arrival, which carries no fee. This record covers only fees for travellers who DO require a visa or VOA.
